documents.population: Kyoto University International Undergraduate Program (Kyoto iUP) applicants, October 2027 enrollment (Faculty of Engineering, Informatics and Mathematical Science is a participating department)
documents.notes: Kyoto iUP Application Guidelines for October 2027 Enrollment (correct as of 1 July 2026; application period 2 November - 3 December 2026; preparatory course from October 2027, undergraduate course from April 2028). The guidelines name an enrollment date, not an academic year, so academic_year is null. Shortlisted applicants mail original documents (transcripts, Form A, Form B, English and standardized test results) by 16 March 2027. Not drafted: Form C (English Proficiency Evaluation Form, an alternative to an English test for native speakers / English-medium secondary education), the resume of educational history for the eligibility screening, optional award and extracurricular documents.

items.quote: Applications, including the submission of the required documents, must be made via the Online Application System.
Digital identification photograph Applicant A digital photograph of the applicant taken within the last six months.
Copy of passport Applicant Copied page(s) containing the applicant's name, photograph, passport number, nationality, and expiration date.
Official transcripts covering the applicant's entire time at secondary/high school from their first year to the present or graduation.

Form A must be completed by the secondary/high school from which the applicant graduated or is expected to graduate. A copy of the original certificate of graduation or high school diploma can also be substituted instead of Form A.
Form B must be filled out in English by a staff member of the secondary/high school that the applicant currently attends or has most recently attended, or by a third party.
Either a specified English proficiency test result or Form C is required.
items.condition: not a native English speaker and secondary education not completed in English (those applicants may submit Form C instead)

items.quote: Applicants must submit their official results for at least one of the standardized tests listed in Appendix 1.
Form D: Essay Applicant The essay must be written in English within the word count specified in Form D, and submitted using Form D.

If documents are in a language other than English, the original documents and their English translation must be submitted together. The English translation must be certified by the issuing school or by a notary office.
items.condition: a document is in a language other than English
